svg.title: HNSW is a skip list whose levels are graphs
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “HNSW is a skip list whose levels are graphs” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn whiteboard with three stacked layers of a navigable small-world graph: a top layer holding 0.39 percent of nodes joined by three long hops, a middle layer with 6.25 percent, and a bottom layer containing every node, with dotted drop lines showing the same node exists in every layer below and a numbered six-step red search path descending greedily to the query cross. Beside it a crossed-out k-d tree square is annotated that in 768 dimensions it visits 94 percent of nodes, an inset shows the two heaps of the inner loop as the week-14 Dijkstra frontier, an IVF panel rings three of seven k-means centroids as nprobe equals three, and three bars compare ef_search 40 at recall 0.95 and 980 QPS against ef_search 10 and brute force.
svg.text: HNSW is a skip list whose levels are graphs
draw it from memory, then compare
